instructions: Value to Owners tab — four Value Creation Scenarios paragraphs in valueOwners.scenarios (blank-line separated).

rows.body:
Independent or soft-brand urban conversion needing recognizable lifestyle retail and restaurant-forward economics.

New construction or adaptive reuse in gateway markets where design-led full-service competes on experience and ADR.

Portfolio owners standardizing on IHG lifestyle after conversion PIP and design narrative alignment.

Third-party operator-led: fits when the operator can run full-service lifestyle F&B, Kimpton design compliance, and IHG systems cutover without constant waivers—management is common while IHG development approves brand milestones.
